# ARKhives 8.21.3

Tiko uses the newest supplied ARKbot_Animated artwork, logo and animation engine without changing their code. The integration adds the Tiko greeting, full motion and enabled sound, with browser audio activated on the first tap. The supplied expressions, sound styles, skins and accessories are available in Tiko settings.

ARKdaily gives Tiko more room by removing the companion heading and bookmark row, moving him upward and using a more translucent glass fade. Daily source/report buttons are removed. Existing saved Daily posts remain available from Tiko settings.

Question choices, answer panels and speech bubbles follow the supplied quiz styling in dark and light mode. Hints appear only when the item already has a hint; the feature does not generate new hints or reveal answers as hints. Rapid user scrolling triggers the existing dizzy animation with a cooldown, while ordinary scrolling and answer feedback keep their normal behavior.

Question banks, explanations, images, notes and study scheduling are preserved. Daily interactions continue to have no effect on study progress or FSRS ratings.
